dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS, germinal-center B-cell-like (Hans algorithm)

stage_i.quote: Ann Arbor / Lugano Stage IA (A: no B symptoms; no E).

stage_nonbulky_no_b.quote: Largest node 3.1 cm, so not bulky by either the 7.5 cm or the 10 cm threshold.

stage_pet_no_marrow_biopsy.quote: Bone marrow biopsy is not needed: PET-CT showed no marrow uptake

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: Not double-expressor: MYC IHC 15% (threshold 40%) and BCL2 IHC 30% (threshold 50%).

prog_ipi_low.quote: IPI 0 (age 45, LDH 190 U/L with ULN 225, ECOG 0, stage I).

tx_curative_rchop.quote: Decision: R-CHOP-21 for 6 cycles at full dose

tx_flyer_4rchop_2r.quote: Decision: R-CHOP-21 for 6 cycles at full dose, with no involved-site radiotherapy

tx_no_rt_goals.quote: she has explicitly declined neck radiation, and her sister's hypothyroidism after neck RT makes that concern real

tx_alternatives.quote: Fallback if she prefers fewer cycles: R-CHOP-21 x 4 followed by thyroid-sparing IMRT 20-30 Gy to the involved neck
tx_alternatives.note: Alternative is 4 cycles plus RT rather than the named 3+RT or PET-adapted 4-cycle approach.

mn_six_cycles.quote: Decision: R-CHOP-21 for 6 cycles at full dose, with no involved-site radiotherapy

cns_low_no_prophylaxis.quote: No CNS prophylaxis: no intrathecal methotrexate and no high-dose methotrexate.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment FDG-PET-CT about 3-5 weeks after cycle 6, scored on the Deauville 5-point scale (Lugano 2014).

resp_interim_pet.quote: Interim PET is not required for this plan

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: HBsAg and anti-HBc negative with anti-HBs positive means no antiviral prophylaxis

work_echo_reviewed.quote: Echo (LVEF 63%, GLS -21%) is adequate for anthracycline.

sup_stop_coc_switch.quote: Bridge today with a progestin-only method (norethindrone pill, acceptable with aura) plus condoms, then place an LNG-IUD before cycle 1

sup_coc_reason.quote: Estrogen-containing contraception is contraindicated with migraine with aura (CDC US MEC category 4, ischemic stroke risk)

sup_fertility_counselling.quote: Fertility: refer to reproductive endocrinology before cycle 1.

fit_goals.quote: Fit for full-intensity curative therapy: ECOG 0, normal renal, hepatic, marrow and cardiac function
